```{python}
#| include: false
# Shim. Three files, in order: the notebook's own furniture, then the chapter's
# aircraft, then how the chapter measures it. All exec'd into the including
# page's namespace. exec rather than import, because every chapter names its
# model `_model` and real imports would collide in sys.modules. Paths are
# relative to the notebook root -- _quarto.yml sets `execute-dir: project`, so
# that is always the cwd.
#
# compile() with the real filename is load-bearing: it sets co_filename, which
# is what lets an entry render a shared function with show_source() and lets
# api() report what already exists. A bare exec() of source text labels every
# function "<string>" and both stop working.
import pathlib

for _p in ["_notebook.py",
           "chapters/02-mceagle-300/_model.py",
           "chapters/02-mceagle-300/_analysis.py"]:
    exec(compile(pathlib.Path(_p).read_text(), _p, "exec"))
```
